title: About Jagadev Associates
intro: Jagadev Associates LLP is a tax, audit and corporate affairs practice in Kothanur, Bengaluru. For about 15 years, the firm has helped small businesses, professionals and salaried individuals stay on the right side of GST, income tax, labour and company law.
story: The practice was founded by Sri. Jagadish Devaraj and works from its own office in Bhoo Vaibhava Layout, off Maha Yogi Vemanna Reddy Road.
Bengaluru traffic should not stand between you and a filing deadline. Clients can visit the office six days a week, or work with us entirely by phone, WhatsApp and email.
